keys: A bridge module (bridge/blendworks_bridge and its commands folder) is matched as py:<file stem>, every other file by its repository path. The first area with a matching rule wins; a file that matches none fails test/tooling/codemap.test.ts.

areas.title: Judge
areas.blurb: src/judge and bridge/judge: spec, rules, measurement stages, visual judge, container entry.

areas.title: MCP server and package build
areas.blurb: src/mcp (server, routing, library), src/package and bridge/package (LODs, gltfpack), src/session.ts, src/blender.ts.

areas.title: Scripts, bench and tests
areas.blurb: scripts/, bench/ and the layout of test/ and bridge/tests/.

areas.title: Bridge core
areas.blurb: handler, registry, schema, policy, limits, util, workspace, plan, validate, autosave, scene, files, checkpoints, images, exports, session and add-on.

areas.title: Animation and rigging
areas.blurb: animation, clips, gaits, posing, rigs, bones, constraints, skinning, weights, shape keys.

areas.title: Sky, weather, atmosphere and render
areas.blurb: sky, clouds, weather, atmosphere, mist, camera, lights, previews, final renders, floating origin.

areas.title: Vegetation and ground cover
areas.blurb: tree_*, trees, woodland*, meadow_*, lsystem*, cover_*, ground_cover, forest_*, distant_forest, impostors, leaf_optics.

areas.title: Terrain, rock and liquids
areas.blurb: heightfields, fluvial terrain, erosion, noise, land and distant land, liquid_*, stones and rock (shape, lithology, weathering, relief), fracture, chip, abrade.

areas.title: Materials and texturing
areas.blurb: materials, procedural presets, PBR, node graphs, masks, wear, baking, UVs, texel density.

areas.title: Shapes and modelling
areas.blurb: sweep, lathe, loft, solids, shells, mesh edits, modifiers, objects, transforms, placement, scatter, engraving, text, cleaning, LODs.
